statements: Makkah was conquered in 8 AH.
The Qur'an was revealed over about 23 years.
Eid al-Fitr comes at the end of Dhul-Hijjah.
easy.explain: Eid al-Fitr is on the 1st of Shawwal, after Ramadan. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Islam is built on seven pillars.
Dhuhr has four rak'ahs.
The prayer ends with the taslim.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said Islam is built on five. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ihram is the sacred state entered before Hajj or Umrah.
The Ka'bah is in Makkah.
Surah Al-Ikhlas describes the Day of Judgement.
easy.explain: Al-Ikhlas says, "Say: He is Allah, the One." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Laylat al-Qadr is sought in the last ten nights of Ramadan.
People who are fasting should wait an hour after sunset to break the fast.
The Prophet ﷺ passed away in Madinah.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said people will remain upon good as long as they hurry to break the fast. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Wudu is required before reading a hadith book.
Muhammad ﷺ is the last prophet.
The Battle of Badr was in the month of Ramadan.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said no prayer is accepted without purification. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Tayammum uses milk when water cannot be found.
Iblis refused to bow down to Adam.
Angels are created from light.
easy.explain: Allah says if you find no water, use clean earth. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Harun was the father of Musa.
The Qur'an was revealed in the month of Ramadan.
Abu Bakr was the first caliph.
easy.explain: Musa asked Allah to strengthen him with his brother Harun. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Muslims believe only in Muhammad ﷺ and no earlier prophet.
Surah Ar-Rahman repeats "Which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?"
The Prophet ﷺ said the strong person controls himself when angry.
easy.explain: Believers make no distinction between any of Allah's messengers. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zakat is paid on wealth held for a full lunar year.
Ali ibn Abi Talib was the second caliph.
The Qur'an was revealed in Arabic.
easy.explain: The order was Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, then Ali. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Yusuf tells one prophet's story from start to end.
There are five obligatory prayers each day.
Umar ibn al-Khattab was the fourth caliph.
easy.explain: Umar was the second caliph. Ali was the fourth. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said suhur should be avoided.
The Qur'an has 114 surahs.
Sa'i is walking between Safa and Marwah.
easy.explain: He said, "Take suhur, for in suhur there is blessing." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Khadijah was the Prophet's first wife.
An-Nas is the last surah of the mushaf.
Ruku' is prostrating in the prayer.
easy.explain: Ruku' is bowing. Prostrating is sujud. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Hasan and Husayn were grandsons of the Prophet ﷺ.
Abu Talib was the Prophet's grandfather.
A Muslim is told to be good to his neighbour.
easy.explain: Abu Talib was his uncle. His grandfather was Abd al-Muttalib. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Masjid an-Nabawi is in Madinah.
Hajj is obligatory once in a lifetime for those who are able.
Ramadan is the twelfth month of the Islamic year.
easy.explain: Ramadan is the ninth month. Dhul-Hijjah is the twelfth. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zamzam water is in Madinah.
There are four sacred months.
Fatimah was the daughter of the Prophet ﷺ.
easy.explain: The well of Zamzam is in Makkah, near the Ka'bah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Baqarah is the longest surah in the Qur'an.
The Prophet's father lived until he became a prophet.
The Prophet ﷺ was born in Makkah.
easy.explain: His father Abdullah died young, and Allah reminds him, "Did He not find you an orphan?" The other two statements are correct.

statements: Adam was created from clay.
"Prayer is better than sleep" is said in the adhan of Isha.
The five daily prayers were made obligatory on the Mi'raj.
easy.explain: The phrase is added to the Fajr adhan. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Fatihah is the first surah of the mushaf.
Jumu'ah prayer is on Friday.
Smiling at your brother is makruh.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Belief in the angels is one of the articles of faith.
The Prophet ﷺ performed Hajj ten times.
Eating with the right hand is sunnah.
easy.explain: Anas said he performed Hajj once. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Isma'il was the son of Ibrahim and Hajar.
Bilal was the first muezzin of Islam.
Fajr has four rak'ahs.
easy.explain: Fajr has two rak'ahs. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Fil tells of the army of the elephant.
Ibrahim built the Ark.
Yunus was swallowed by a great fish.
easy.explain: Allah told Nuh to build the ship. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Kawthar is the shortest surah, with three ayat.
"Alhamdulillah" is said after sneezing.
Saying "Bismillah" is sunnah only after eating.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ told a boy, "Say Bismillah and eat with your right hand." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Kahf tells the story of the People of the Elephant.
The Qur'an is divided into 30 juz.
Muharram is the first month of the Islamic year.
easy.explain: Al-Kahf tells of the sleepers in the cave. Al-Fil tells of the elephant. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Dawud was given the Zabur.
Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.
The Hijrah was the migration from Madinah to Makkah.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ migrated from Makkah to Madinah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Musa was given the Tawrat.
Ayat al-Kursi is in Surah Al-Baqarah.
Muslims pray facing Masjid an-Nabawi.
easy.explain: The qiblah is the Ka'bah in the Masjid al-Haram. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Fatihah has seven ayat.
The Prophet's mother was Aminah.
Eid al-Adha falls in Rajab.
easy.explain: Eid al-Adha is on the 10th of Dhul-Hijjah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zakat is a pillar of Islam.
Nuh was the first human being.
Umrah can be performed at any time of the year.
easy.explain: Allah created Adam first, and from him his mate. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Musa's staff turned into a snake.
The Prophet ﷺ said actions are judged only by their results.
The first word revealed was "Read" (Iqra').
easy.explain: The first hadith in al-Bukhari: actions are by intentions. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The day of Arafah is the 1st of Shawwal.
Jinn are created from smokeless fire.
Washing the face is part of wudu.
easy.explain: Pilgrims stand at Arafah on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah, the day before Eid al-Adha. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Smiling is a sign of a hypocrite.
Masjid al-Aqsa is in Jerusalem.
Charity does not decrease wealth.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said the signs of a hypocrite are lying, breaking promises and betraying trust. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Suhur is the meal after sunset.
Uthman ibn Affan was the third caliph.
Fasting in Ramadan is one of the pillars of Islam.
easy.explain: Suhur is eaten before dawn. The meal at sunset is iftar. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Nuh could understand the speech of birds.
Yusuf was thrown into a well by his brothers.
The Islamic calendar begins with the Hijrah.
easy.explain: Sulayman said, "We have been taught the language of birds." The other two statements are correct.

statements: The first revelation came in the cave of Thawr.
The Isra was the journey from Makkah to Jerusalem by night.
The Ka'bah was rebuilt by Quraysh when the Prophet ﷺ was young.
easy.explain: Revelation began in the cave of Hira. Thawr is where the Prophet ﷺ hid during the Hijrah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zakat al-Fitr is given before the Eid prayer.
Muslims greet each other with "As-salamu alaykum".
The Islamic calendar is solar.
easy.explain: The months follow the moon. Allah says the new moons are signs of time for people and for Hajj. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Maryam is the only woman named in the Qur'an.
The adhan is the call to break the fast only.
The Prophet ﷺ named the mother three times as the most deserving of good company.
easy.explain: The adhan announces the time of every obligatory prayer. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Maryam is named after the mother of Isa.
Maghrib has three rak'ahs.
Mika'il brought the revelation to the Prophet ﷺ.
easy.explain: Jibril (Gabriel) brought the Qur'an down to the Prophet's heart. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Pilgrims stone the Jamarat at Mina.
Isa was the son of Zakariyya.
The Islamic year has twelve months.
easy.explain: Isa was born to Maryam miraculously. Zakariyya's son was Yahya. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Tawaf is walking around the Ka'bah three times.
Ibrahim was thrown into a fire and was not harmed.
Ya'qub was the father of Yusuf.
easy.explain: Tawaf is seven circuits around the Ka'bah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Fatihah does not begin with the basmalah.
Ashura is on the 10th of Muharram.
Ibrahim and Isma'il raised the foundations of the Ka'bah.
easy.explain: At-Tawbah is the only surah that does not open with the basmalah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Masjid Quba is in Madinah.
Allah promised to preserve the Qur'an.
Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas are about the battle of Badr.
easy.explain: Both surahs begin, "Say: I seek refuge." The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Isra was the journey from Makkah to Madinah by day.
Jibril brought the revelation to the Prophet ﷺ.
Ramadan is the ninth month of the Islamic year.
easy.explain: Surah Al-Isra describes the night journey from the Inviolable Mosque to the Far Mosque. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Makkah was conquered in 2 AH.
Nuh built the Ark.
The Qur'an is divided into 30 juz.
easy.explain: The conquest of Makkah was in Ramadan, 8 AH. Badr was in 2 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Ikhlas describes the oneness of Allah.
Fasting in Shawwal is one of the pillars of Islam.
Muhammad ﷺ is the last prophet.
easy.explain: The pillar is fasting Ramadan, not Shawwal. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Qur'an was revealed in Persian.
Jumu'ah prayer is on Friday.
Fatimah was the daughter of the Prophet ﷺ.
easy.explain: Allah says, "We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an." The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ named the mother three times as the most deserving of good company.
The Prophet ﷺ performed Hajj once.
Yusuf was thrown into the sea by his brothers.
easy.explain: Yusuf's brothers threw him into the depths of a well. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Yusuf tells the story of Nuh.
Maryam is the only woman named in the Qur'an.
Isma'il was the son of Ibrahim and Hajar.
easy.explain: Surah Yusuf tells the story of Yusuf in one surah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zamzam water is in Makkah.
Dhuhr has three rak'ahs.
Musa was given the Tawrat.
easy.explain: Dhuhr has four rak'ahs. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said the strong person controls himself when angry.
The Qur'an was revealed over about 23 years.
Laylat al-Qadr is sought in the first ten nights of Ramadan.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said to seek it in the odd nights of the last ten. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas seek refuge in Allah.
Isa was born to Maryam without a father.
The Ka'bah was first built by Quraysh.
easy.explain: Ibrahim and Isma'il raised its foundations. Quraysh rebuilt it in the Prophet's youth. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Hijrah was the migration from Makkah to Madinah.
Tayammum uses clean earth when water cannot be found.
Jinn are created from light.
easy.explain: Allah says He created the jinn from smokeless fire. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Yunus was swallowed by a great fish.
Khadijah was the Prophet's first wife.
Pilgrims stone the Jamarat at Arafah.
easy.explain: The stoning of the Jamarat takes place in Mina. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Fajr has two rak'ahs.
The prayer ends with the iqamah.
Tawaf is walking around the Ka'bah seven times.
easy.explain: The prayer begins with takbir and ends with taslim. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Islamic calendar begins with the Hijrah.
Washing the whole body is part of wudu.
"Alhamdulillah" is said after sneezing.
easy.explain: Wudu is washing the face, arms, wiping the head and washing the feet. Washing the whole body is ghusl. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Eid al-Adha falls in Dhul-Hijjah.
Jibril refused to bow down to Adam.
Surah At-Tawbah does not begin with the basmalah.
easy.explain: All the angels bowed except Iblis. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Angels are created from clay.
Sa'i is walking between Safa and Marwah.
Umar ibn al-Khattab was the second caliph.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said angels were created from light, jinn from smokeless fire, and Adam from what was described to you. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zakat al-Fitr is given at the end of Dhul-Hijjah.
Abu Talib was the Prophet's uncle.
The Prophet ﷺ was an orphan.
easy.explain: The Prophet ﷺ ordered zakat al-fitr to be paid before people go out to the Eid prayer. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Baqarah repeats "Which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?" many times.
Umrah can be performed at any time of the year.
People who are fasting should hurry to break the fast at sunset.
easy.explain: This refrain runs through Surah Ar-Rahman. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Charity does not decrease wealth.
Bilal was the first muezzin of Islam.
Masjid al-Aqsa is in Damascus.
easy.explain: Masjid al-Aqsa is in Jerusalem. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Muharram is the first month of the Islamic year.
Masjid Quba is in Madinah.
The Qur'an says it will be changed over time.
easy.explain: Allah says, "We have sent down the Reminder and We will preserve it." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ya'qub was the father of Yusuf.
Laylat al-Qadr is better than a hundred months.
An-Nas is the last surah of the mushaf.
easy.explain: Surah Al-Qadr says it is better than a thousand months. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Harun was the brother of Musa.
Surah Al-Fil tells of the army of the elephant.
There are three obligatory prayers each day.
easy.explain: Five prayers are obligatory every day and night. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Muslims greet each other with "Allahu Akbar".
Surah Al-Kahf tells the story of the People of the Cave.
"Prayer is better than sleep" is said in the adhan of Fajr.
easy.explain: The greeting of Islam is salam. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ayat al-Kursi is in Surah Ali 'Imran.
Abu Bakr was the first caliph.
Suhur is the meal before dawn.
easy.explain: Ayat al-Kursi is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Eid al-Fitr comes at the end of Ramadan.
Maghrib has three rak'ahs.
Adam was created from fire.
easy.explain: Allah created man from clay. Iblis boasted that he was made of fire. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said there is blessing in suhur.
Al-Ikhlas is the shortest surah, with two ayat.
The first word revealed was "Read" (Iqra').
easy.explain: Al-Kawthar is the shortest surah. Al-Ikhlas has four ayat. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ibrahim was thrown into the sea and was not harmed.
Hajj is obligatory once in a lifetime for those who are able.
Musa's staff turned into a snake.
easy.explain: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety for Ibrahim." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Islam is built on five pillars.
The Prophet ﷺ was born in Madinah.
Ihram is the sacred state entered before Hajj or Umrah.
easy.explain: He was born in Makkah and migrated to Madinah later. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zakat is paid on wealth held for a single day.
Surah Maryam is named after the mother of Isa.
Sulayman could understand the speech of birds.
easy.explain: Zakat is due on savings above the nisab held for a lunar year. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Eating with the right hand is sunnah.
The Islamic calendar is lunar.
Ali 'Imran is the longest surah in the Qur'an.
easy.explain: Al-Baqarah, with 286 ayat, is the longest surah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Dawud was given the Tawrat.
Muslims pray facing the Ka'bah.
Muslims believe in all the prophets.
easy.explain: Allah says He gave Dawud the Zabur (Psalms). The other two statements are correct.

statements: There are six sacred months.
The five daily prayers were made obligatory on the Mi'raj.
The Prophet's mother was Aminah.
easy.explain: Allah says that of the twelve months, four are sacred. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Hasan and Husayn were grandsons of the Prophet ﷺ.
Saying "Bismillah" is sunnah before eating.
The Qur'an was first revealed in the month of Muharram.
easy.explain: Allah says Ramadan is the month in which the Qur'an was revealed. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ali ibn Abi Talib was the fourth caliph.
Uthman ibn Affan was the first caliph.
The adhan is the call to prayer.
easy.explain: Uthman was the third caliph, after Abu Bakr and Umar. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ passed away in Madinah.
The Ka'bah is in Jerusalem.
The Islamic year has twelve months.
easy.explain: The Ka'bah is in Makkah. Masjid al-Aqsa is in Jerusalem. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The day of Arafah is the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah.
Lying is a sign of a hypocrite.
Belief in the angels is not part of faith.
easy.explain: In the hadith of Jibril, faith includes belief in Allah, His angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and qadar. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Masjid an-Nabawi is in Makkah.
The Prophet ﷺ said actions are judged by intentions.
Smiling at your brother is a charity.
easy.explain: The Prophet's Mosque is in Madinah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The last two verses of Al-Fatihah suffice the one who recites them at night.
Harut and Marut were sent down in Babylon.
The Prophet ﷺ said none of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said whoever recites the last two verses of Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The archers' leaving their post turned the tide at Uhud.
Yunus is called Dhun-Nun in the Qur'an.
Fasting the day of Arafah expiates ten years of sins.
medium.explain: It expiates the year before and the year after. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Qarun was swallowed by the earth.
Al-Khidr built a boat to escape a flood.
The Prophet ﷺ travelled to Ta'if to invite its people.
medium.explain: He made a hole in the boat because a king was seizing every good boat. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Sulayman had jinn working for him.
Abu Ubaydah was called the trustworthy one of this ummah.
Imran was the guardian of Maryam in the sanctuary.
medium.explain: Allah placed Maryam in the care of Zakariyya. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Asr says mankind is in loss except those who believe and do good.
Kindness to parents comes right after worshipping Allah in Surah Al-Isra.
Abu Bakr was called the Sword of Allah.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ called Khalid a sword from the swords of Allah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zayd ibn Harithah is the only companion named in the Qur'an.
Hajar ran between Arafah and Mina seven times.
Uthman married two daughters of the Prophet ﷺ.
medium.explain: Hajar ran between Safa and Marwah looking for water, and pilgrims do the same. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Abu Jahl is named in the Qur'an.
Anas ibn Malik served the Prophet ﷺ for ten years.
The Muslims first faced Jerusalem in prayer.
medium.explain: Surah Al-Masad names Abu Lahab. Abu Jahl is not named. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Abu Hurayrah narrated more hadith than any other companion.
The Battle of Hunayn is named in the Qur'an.
The Qur'an forbids honey and milk.
medium.explain: Surah Al-Ma'idah calls wine and gambling an abomination of Satan's work. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The best prayer after the obligatory ones is the night prayer.
Talut killed Jalut.
The qiblah was changed in the second year after the Hijrah.
medium.explain: Allah says Dawud killed Jalut. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Allah says the most honoured of you is the most righteous.
Travellers may shorten four-rak'ah prayers to two.
"Today I have perfected your religion" was revealed at Badr.
medium.explain: Umar said this verse was revealed on a Friday, while the Prophet ﷺ stood at Arafah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Khalid ibn al-Walid led the gathering of the Qur'an.
Luqman advised his son not to associate partners with Allah.
Zakat has eight categories of recipients.
medium.explain: Abu Bakr gave the task to Zayd ibn Thabit, a scribe of revelation. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said Paradise is surrounded by hardships.
Ayyub is known for his patience in illness.
A trench was dug around Makkah in the Battle of Hunayn.
medium.explain: The trench (khandaq) protected Madinah against the Confederates. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Qadr says the angels and the Spirit descend on Laylat al-Qadr.
Fish is forbidden in the Qur'an.
Surah Al-Kahf is recommended on Fridays.
medium.explain: The Qur'an forbids carrion, blood and the flesh of swine. Seafood is lawful. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Musa met al-Khidr in Egypt's palace.
The Year of Sorrow saw the deaths of Abu Talib and Khadijah.
Backbiting is compared in the Qur'an to eating a dead brother's flesh.
medium.explain: Musa travelled to the junction of the two seas to meet the servant of Allah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Allah says in Surah Al-Baqarah that He is near and answers the caller.
There are fifteen places of prostration in the Qur'an in the common count.
Shaytan flees from a house where poetry is recited.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said Shaytan flees from the house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Dhul-Qarnayn built a wall of iron and copper.
Trade is forbidden in the Qur'an.
The Prophet ﷺ said the upper hand is better than the lower hand.
medium.explain: Allah permitted trade and forbade usury. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said the strongest believer is more beloved to Allah than the weak one, and in both there is good.
Lut's people lived in the time of Ibrahim.
Pilgrims spend the night at Ta'if after Arafah.
medium.explain: After sunset at Arafah they go to Muzdalifah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Qur'an was first gathered into one volume under Ali.
Abu Bakr accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah.
The Dajjal is blind in one eye.
medium.explain: After Yamamah, Zayd ibn Thabit gathered it under Abu Bakr. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Sujud is the position in which a servant is closest to his Lord.
Uthman slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the Hijrah.
Isma'il helped his father build the Ka'bah.
medium.explain: Ali stayed behind in his bed and later returned the trusts people had left with the Prophet ﷺ. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ya'juj and Ma'juj were held back by a barrier.
The Qur'an calls the believers brothers.
The first migration was to Yemen.
medium.explain: Persecuted Muslims first migrated to Abyssinia, ruled by the Negus. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The angels Munkar and Nakir question the dead in the grave.
Isa will return before the end of time.
Fasting Ashura expiates the next ten years.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said it expiates the year before. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Uthman sent standard copies of the Qur'an to the main cities.
Hud was sent to the people of Thamud.
The Prophet ﷺ said whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or stay silent.
medium.explain: Hud was sent to 'Ad. Salih was sent to Thamud. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Expedition of Tabuk was against the Byzantines.
Hamzah was martyred at Badr.
The Hijrah took place in 622 CE.
medium.explain: Hamzah fought at Badr and was martyred at Uhud. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Muslims at Badr numbered a little over three hundred.
The Muhajirun were the Muslims who migrated from Makkah.
Witr is prayed before Fajr's adhan only on Fridays.
medium.explain: Witr is prayed between Isha and Fajr. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Every child is born on the fitrah.
The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was made with Quraysh.
The Prophet ﷺ said the best of you are those who own the most land.
medium.explain: He said, "The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Fatihah is recited in every rak'ah of the prayer.
Mu'adh ibn Jabal was sent to Persia.
Surah Al-Fath was revealed after Hudaybiyyah.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ sent Mu'adh to Yemen. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Ikhlas is equal to a third of the Qur'an.
Haman was the brother of Musa.
I'tikaf is usually done in the last ten days of Ramadan.
medium.explain: Haman served Fir'awn. Musa's brother was Harun. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Hujurat teaches not to mock other people.
The Prophet ﷺ said the most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.
The Prophet ﷺ said the world is a paradise for the believer.
medium.explain: The world is the believer's prison and the disbeliever's paradise. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Battle of Badr was the first major battle of Islam.
The Prophet ﷺ said a surah of thirty verses, Al-Mulk, intercedes for the one who recites it.
Allah says with ease comes only hardship.
medium.explain: Surah Ash-Sharh: with hardship comes ease, twice. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ayat al-Kursi is the greatest verse in the Qur'an.
Surah Al-Ma'un praises those who pray only to be seen.
The People of the Cave slept for 309 years.
medium.explain: It warns "those who want to be seen". The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ prayed at night until his feet swelled.
Ibrahim's father was named Azar in the Qur'an.
Allah says people must be forced into religion.
medium.explain: Al-Baqarah 256: there is no compulsion in religion. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Ansar were the Muslims of Madinah.
Tahajjud is prayed at noon.
Yahya was the son of Zakariyya.
medium.explain: Allah tells the Prophet ﷺ, "And in some part of the night, pray tahajjud." The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ encouraged cutting ties with relatives.
The miqat for the people of Madinah is Dhul-Hulayfah.
Malik is the keeper of Hell.
medium.explain: He said the one who cuts ties of kinship will not enter Paradise. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zamzam appeared for Hajar and her son.
Salih was sent to Thamud.
Shu'ayb was sent to 'Ad.
medium.explain: Shu'ayb was sent to Madyan. Hud was sent to 'Ad. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Allah burdens every soul beyond what it can bear.
The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was made with Quraysh.
The Farewell Pilgrimage was in 10 AH.
medium.explain: The end of Al-Baqarah says Allah tasks no soul beyond its capacity. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Mu'awiyah sent standard copies of the Qur'an to the main cities.
The miqat for the people of Madinah is Dhul-Hulayfah.
Isma'il helped his father build the Ka'bah.
medium.explain: Uthman had copies made from Hafsah's sheets and sent them out. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ayyub is known for building the Ka'bah.
The Prophet ﷺ said none of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Abu Lahab is the only opponent of the Prophet named in the Qur'an.
medium.explain: Allah says of Ayyub, "We found him patient." The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Qur'an forbids wine and gambling.
The Prophet ﷺ said the world is a prison for the believer.
Hajar ran between Arafah and Mina seven times.
medium.explain: Hajar ran between Safa and Marwah looking for water, and pilgrims do the same. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Zakat has three categories of recipients.
The Qur'an was first gathered into one volume under Abu Bakr.
Pork is forbidden in the Qur'an.
medium.explain: Surah At-Tawbah lists eight categories. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said the best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
Allah says with hardship comes ease.
The Muslims at Badr numbered about three thousand.
medium.explain: Al-Bara' said the people of Badr were about the number of Talut's men, a little over three hundred. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Muhajirun were the Muslims who migrated from Makkah.
Khalid was called the trustworthy one of this ummah.
Abu Bakr accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said the trustworthy one of this ummah is Abu Ubaydah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said the Fire is surrounded by hardships.
Zayd ibn Harithah is the only companion named in the Qur'an.
The Muslims first faced Jerusalem in prayer.
medium.explain: Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and the Fire by desires. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ prayed at night until his feet swelled.
Lut's people lived in the time of Ibrahim.
The Prophet ﷺ said the most beloved deeds to Allah are the biggest, even if rare.
medium.explain: The most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular, even if little. The other two statements are correct.

statements: I'tikaf is only allowed in the first ten days of Ramadan.
The last two verses of Al-Baqarah suffice the one who recites them at night.
The Ansar were the Muslims of Madinah.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ used to make i'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Allah says in Surah Al-Baqarah that He is far and does not answer.
The People of the Cave slept for 309 years.
Surah Al-Ikhlas is equal to a third of the Qur'an.
medium.explain: When My servants ask you about Me, I am near. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Allah says there is no compulsion in religion.
A trench was dug around Madinah in the Battle of the Confederates.
Ruku' is the position in which a servant is closest to his Lord.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said the closest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Pilgrims spend the night at Muzdalifah after Arafah.
Witr is prayed after Isha.
Anas ibn Malik served the Prophet ﷺ for two years.
medium.explain: Anas said he served the Prophet ﷺ for ten years. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Kahf is recommended on Mondays.
Travellers may shorten four-rak'ah prayers to two.
Shu'ayb was sent to Madyan.
medium.explain: Reciting Al-Kahf on Friday is narrated to bring light between the two Fridays. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Qur'an calls the believers brothers.
Surah Al-Fath was revealed after Hudaybiyyah.
Surah Al-Qadr says the jinn descend on Laylat al-Qadr.
medium.explain: Surah Al-Qadr: the angels and the Spirit descend in it by the permission of their Lord. The other two statements are correct.

statements: There are fifteen places of prostration in the Qur'an in the common count.
The Prophet ﷺ forbade cutting ties of kinship.
Ridwan is named in the Qur'an as the keeper of Hell.
medium.explain: The Qur'an names Malik as the keeper of the Fire. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Musa met al-Khidr where the two seas meet.
Al-Khidr damaged a boat to save it from a king.
Surah Al-Asr says mankind is always successful.
medium.explain: Al-Asr: man is in loss, except those who believe, do righteous deeds and counsel truth and patience. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Fatihah is recited in every rak'ah of the prayer.
Salih was sent to Madyan.
Surah Al-Ma'un warns those who pray only to be seen.
medium.explain: Salih was sent to Thamud. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Fasting the day of Arafah expiates two years of sins.
Mu'adh ibn Jabal was sent to Yemen.
Abu Bakr was called the Sword of Allah.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ called Khalid a sword from the swords of Allah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Farewell Pilgrimage was in 10 AH.
Haman was the minister of Fir'awn.
The Prophet ﷺ travelled to Damascus to invite its people.
medium.explain: He went to Ta'if, and its people rejected him. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The qiblah was changed in the tenth year after the Hijrah.
Ya'juj and Ma'juj were held back by a barrier.
Allah says the most honoured of you is the most righteous.
medium.explain: The qiblah changed about sixteen or seventeen months after the Hijrah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Fasting Ashura expiates the previous year.
The Battle of Badr was the first major battle of Islam.
Harut and Marut were sent down in Makkah.
medium.explain: Al-Baqarah places them in Babylon. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said the strongest believer is more beloved to Allah than the weak one, and in both there is good.
Surah Al-Hujurat teaches not to mock other people.
Ali married two daughters of the Prophet ﷺ.
medium.explain: Uthman married Ruqayyah and then Umm Kulthum. Ali married Fatimah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Expedition of Tabuk was against the Persians.
Yunus is called Dhun-Nun in the Qur'an.
Sulayman had jinn working for him.
medium.explain: Tabuk, in 9 AH, was a march north to face the Byzantines. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Hud was sent to the people of 'Ad.
The best prayer after the obligatory ones is the Duha prayer.
Zayd ibn Thabit led the gathering of the Qur'an.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said the best prayer after the obligatory ones is the prayer at night. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said Surah Al-Kawthar intercedes for the one who recites it until he is forgiven.
Every child is born on the fitrah.
The Dajjal is blind in one eye.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said a surah of thirty verses interceded for a man until he was forgiven: Tabarak alladhi biyadihil-mulk. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The archers' leaving their post turned the tide at Badr.
The first migration was to Abyssinia.
Backbiting is compared in the Qur'an to eating a dead brother's flesh.
medium.explain: At Uhud the archers left the hill against orders, and the Muslims were attacked from behind. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Interest (riba) is forbidden in the Qur'an.
Hamzah was martyred at Uhud.
Surah Al-Isra allows saying "uff" to parents.
medium.explain: Al-Isra commands goodness to parents and forbids even saying "uff". The other two statements are correct.

statements: Yahya was the son of Imran.
Abu Hurayrah narrated more hadith than any other companion.
Ayat al-Kursi is the greatest verse in the Qur'an.
medium.explain: Yahya was born to Zakariyya in his old age. The other two statements are correct.

statements: "Today I have perfected your religion" was revealed at Arafah.
The angels Munkar and Nakir question the dead in the grave.
Qarun drowned in the sea.
medium.explain: Allah caused the earth to swallow Qarun. Fir'awn drowned. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Dawud killed Jalut.
Luqman advised his son not to associate partners with Allah.
The Year of Sorrow saw the deaths of Abu Bakr and Umar.
medium.explain: Abu Talib and Khadijah died in the same year, before the Hijrah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
The Battle of Uhud is named in the Qur'an.
Shaytan flees from a house where Al-Baqarah is recited.
medium.explain: Surah At-Tawbah names Hunayn. Uhud is described but not named. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ibrahim's father was named Imran in the Qur'an.
Tahajjud is prayed at night.
Zamzam appeared for Hajar and her son.
medium.explain: Surah Al-An'am names Ibrahim's father Azar. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet ﷺ said the upper hand is better than the lower hand.
The Prophet ﷺ said whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or stay silent.
The Hijrah took place in 610 CE.
medium.explain: The Hijrah was in 622 CE. Revelation began around 610 CE. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ali slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the Hijrah.
Musa will return before the end of time.
Zakariyya was the guardian of Maryam.
medium.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said the son of Maryam will descend as a just ruler. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Cordoba was the last Muslim kingdom in al-Andalus to fall.
Qarn al-Manazil is the miqat for the people of Najd.
A fifth of the spoils is set aside in Surah Al-Anfal.
hard.explain: Granada fell last, in 897 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The name Muhammad appears four times in the Qur'an.
The Battle of Yamamah was fought against the Byzantines.
Ahmad ibn Hanbal studied under al-Shafi'i.
hard.explain: Yamamah was fought against the false prophet Musaylimah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Yahya spoke as a baby in the cradle to defend his mother.
The Prophet ﷺ was shrouded in three white cloths.
Ibn Kathir was a student of Ibn Taymiyyah.
hard.explain: Isa spoke from the cradle to defend Maryam. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Throne shook at the death of Sa'd ibn Mu'adh.
Abu Bakr's caliphate lasted about twenty years.
The sheets of the Qur'an were kept with Hafsah before Uthman's copies.
hard.explain: He ruled from 11 to 13 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ahmad ibn Hanbal was persecuted in the Mihnah over the createdness of the Qur'an.
A hadith qudsi is part of the Qur'an.
Surah Al-Hashr was revealed about Banu al-Nadir.
hard.explain: A hadith qudsi conveys Allah's words in the Prophet's narration, but it is not Qur'an. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The flood of 'Arim destroyed the people of Lut.
Ammar ibn Yasir was killed at Siffin.
Twenty-five prophets are named in the Qur'an.
hard.explain: Allah sent upon Saba' the flood of al-'Arim. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Mongols sacked Baghdad in 656 AH.
The Prophet ﷺ met Ibrahim in the seventh heaven on the Mi'raj.
Fatimah is called the one with two waistbands.
hard.explain: Asma tore her waistband in two for the Hijrah provisions. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Imam al-Bukhari died in 156 AH.
The incident of the Ifk happened on the return from Banu al-Mustaliq.
The Hijri calendar was adopted under Umar.
hard.explain: Al-Bukhari died in 256 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Umayyad capital was Baghdad.
The People of the Ditch are mentioned in Surah Al-Buruj.
Al-Buraq was the mount of the Night Journey.
hard.explain: The Umayyads ruled from Damascus. Baghdad was the Abbasid capital. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Abdullah ibn Ubayy withdrew about a third of the army before Uhud.
The Prophet ﷺ made qunut against the killers of the reciters for a month.
The People of the Sabbath were turned into stone.
hard.explain: Allah said to them, "Be apes, despised." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Musa is called Kalimullah because Allah spoke to him directly.
Seventy reciters were killed at Bi'r Ma'unah.
Ahmad ibn Hanbal compiled al-Muwatta'.
hard.explain: Malik compiled al-Muwatta'. Ahmad compiled the Musnad. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ibn Hisham edited the Sirah of Ibn Ishaq.
Ibn Hajar compiled Riyad as-Salihin.
The plague of Amwas struck al-Sham in Umar's time.
hard.explain: Riyad as-Salihin is al-Nawawi's. Ibn Hajar wrote Bulugh al-Maram. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ka'b ibn Malik was one of the three who stayed behind from Tabuk.
The miqat for the people of al-Sham is al-Juhfah.
Baghdad was founded by Umar ibn al-Khattab.
hard.explain: Al-Mansur founded Baghdad in 145 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: In li'an each spouse swears four times and then a fifth oath.
A bequest may cover the whole estate even with heirs.
Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas commanded the Muslims at Qadisiyyah.
hard.explain: The Prophet ﷺ told Sa'd, "A third, and a third is much." The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Mujadilah mentions the name of Allah in every verse.
The Qur'an was gathered under Abu Bakr after many reciters died at Yamamah.
Hafs narrated the recitation of Nafi'.
hard.explain: Hafs is 'Asim's narrator. Warsh and Qalun narrate from Nafi'. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Umar set Dhat 'Irq as the miqat for Iraq.
Imam Muslim was a student of al-Bukhari.
The six books of hadith include Musnad Ahmad.
hard.explain: The six are al-Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, al-Tirmidhi, al-Nasa'i and Ibn Majah. The Musnad is not among them. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The man who died for a hundred years found his food unspoiled.
The Battle of the Camel was fought near Makkah.
The Qur'an calls Ibrahim "Khalil", the intimate friend of Allah.
hard.explain: The Camel (36 AH) was fought near Basra. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Salah al-Din retook Jerusalem after the Battle of Hattin.
A widow's waiting period is three days.
Abu Musa al-Ash'ari came from Yemen.
hard.explain: Al-Baqarah 234 sets four months and ten days. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Banu Qaynuqa' were the first Jewish tribe expelled from Madinah.
Kalalah is someone who leaves neither parent nor child.
The Prophet ﷺ forbade shaving the head in Hajj.
hard.explain: He prayed for those who shave, then included those who trim. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Abu Dharr's name was Jundub ibn Junadah.
A mawquf report is raised to the Prophet ﷺ.
The Prophet ﷺ performed four umrahs.
hard.explain: Mawquf stops at a companion. A report raised to the Prophet ﷺ is marfu'. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Samiri made the golden calf.
Abdullah ibn Salam was a Jewish scholar of Madinah before Islam.
Malik studied under al-Shafi'i.
hard.explain: Al-Shafi'i, the younger, studied the Muwatta' under Malik in Madinah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet's she-camel al-Qaswa' knelt at Badr and refused to fight.
Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ruled for about two and a half years.
Ahmad, as a name of the Prophet ﷺ, appears in Surah As-Saff.
hard.explain: Al-Qaswa' knelt at Hudaybiyyah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Salman al-Farisi came from Persia.
Hafsah was the daughter of Abu Bakr.
Al-Tabari wrote both a tafsir and a history.
hard.explain: Hafsah was Umar's daughter. Aishah was Abu Bakr's. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Umar's caliphate lasted about one year.
Ayat al-Dayn is the longest verse in the Qur'an.
A mursal hadith omits the companion from the chain.
hard.explain: Umar ruled from 13 to 23 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Seven angels enter al-Bayt al-Ma'mur every year.
Talut tested his army by forbidding them to drink from a river.
The Qur'an gives the husband four months in the case of ila'.
hard.explain: The Prophet ﷺ was told seventy thousand angels pray in it daily. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The prayers were first prescribed as three and increased to five.
Musa is the prophet named most often in the Qur'an.
The expiation for zihar includes fasting two consecutive months.
hard.explain: On Musa's advice the Prophet ﷺ asked for a reduction until they became five. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Thumamah ibn Uthal was tied to a pillar of the mosque before accepting Islam.
Zayd is named in Surah Al-Ahzab.
Days of Tashriq are the first three days of Shawwal.
hard.explain: They are the three days after the Day of Sacrifice. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Surah Al-Kahf contains a basmalah in the middle of the surah.
The white days are the 13th, 14th and 15th of the lunar month.
Ibn Hajar wrote Fath al-Bari on Sahih al-Bukhari.
hard.explain: Sulayman's letter in Surah An-Naml begins with the basmalah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Aishah gave her day to Sawdah.
The believer of Fir'awn's family hid his faith.
Abu Hanifah died in 150 AH.
hard.explain: Sawdah gave her turn to Aishah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Dhul-Qarnayn stayed in one city all his life.
Hudhayfah urged Uthman to unify the copies of the Qur'an.
Sa'd ibn Mu'adh judged the case of Banu Qurayzah.
hard.explain: Al-Kahf describes his journeys west and east. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Idris is named twenty times in the Qur'an.
The Battle of Ain Jalut was fought against the Mongols.
The siege of Ta'if came after the Battle of Hunayn.
hard.explain: Idris is named in Maryam and Al-Anbiya. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Dome of the Rock was built under Harun al-Rashid.
Umar was stabbed while leading the prayer in the mosque.
Umar appointed six men to choose the next caliph.
hard.explain: Abd al-Malik built it, completed in 72 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Khidr demanded payment for rebuilding a wall.
Zaynab bint Jahsh was previously married to Zayd ibn Harithah.
Safiyyah's dowry was her freedom.
hard.explain: Musa suggested payment, but al-Khidr repaired it freely for two orphans. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Prophet's ring was engraved "Muhammad Messenger of Allah".
Juwayriyah was the daughter of the chief of Quraysh.
Expiation for a broken oath can be feeding ten poor people.
hard.explain: She was the daughter of the chief of Banu al-Mustaliq. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari is buried near Constantinople.
Umar entered al-Sham during the plague to lead the prayer there.
Al-Shafi'i died in Egypt.
hard.explain: On hearing the Prophet's instruction he returned. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Uthman was martyred at Siffin.
Al-Tirmidhi often graded hadith as hasan in his Jami'.
Zaynab bint Jahsh was previously married to Zayd ibn Harithah.
hard.explain: Uthman was killed by rebels in his house in 35 AH. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The miqat for the people of al-Sham is al-Juhfah.
Sa'd ibn Mu'adh judged the case of Banu Qurayzah.
Seven hundred reciters were killed at Bi'r Ma'unah.
hard.explain: The Prophet ﷺ sent seventy reciters, who were betrayed and killed. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Banu Qaynuqa' were the first Jewish tribe expelled from Madinah.
A fifth of the spoils is set aside in Surah Al-Anfal.
Surah Al-Hashr was revealed about Abu Lahab.
hard.explain: Ibn Abbas called Al-Hashr the surah of Banu al-Nadir. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Imam al-Bukhari was a student of Imam Muslim.
The Battle of Ain Jalut was fought against the Mongols.
Abdullah ibn Salam was a Jewish scholar of Madinah before Islam.
hard.explain: Muslim studied under al-Bukhari, who was older. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Qur'an was gathered under Abu Bakr after many reciters died at Badr.
A hadith qudsi is narrated by the Prophet ﷺ from Allah.
In li'an each spouse swears four times and then a fifth oath.
hard.explain: Umar urged Abu Bakr after many reciters were killed at Yamamah. The other two statements are correct.

The Battle of the Camel was fought near Basra.
Idris is named twice in the Qur'an.
hard.explain: They are the three days after the Day of Sacrifice. The other two statements are correct.

Ahmad, as a name of the Prophet ﷺ, appears in Surah As-Saff.
Zayd is named in Surah Al-Baqarah.
hard.explain: Al-Ahzab 37 names Zayd. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Hijri calendar was adopted under Umar.
The Prophet ﷺ met Ibrahim in the first heaven on the Mi'raj.
The sheets of the Qur'an were kept with Hafsah before Uthman's copies.
hard.explain: He met Adam in the first heaven and Ibrahim in the seventh. The other two statements are correct.

Umar's caliphate lasted about ten years.
Baghdad was founded by the Abbasid caliph al-Mansur.
hard.explain: Al-Shafi'i spent his last years in Egypt and died there in 204 AH. The other two statements are correct.

Safiyyah's dowry was her freedom.
Malik ibn Anas compiled al-Muwatta'.
hard.explain: Fath al-Bari explains Sahih al-Bukhari. Al-Nawawi's commentary is on Sahih Muslim. The other two statements are correct.

The plague of Amwas struck Makkah in Abu Bakr's time.

hard.explain: It struck al-Sham around 18 AH, and Abu Ubaydah died in it. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Granada was the last Muslim kingdom in al-Andalus.
Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ruled for about forty years.
Uthman was martyred in his house in Madinah.
hard.explain: He ruled from 99 to 101 AH. The other two statements are correct.

The Mongols sacked Baghdad in 656 AH.
Qarn al-Manazil is the miqat for the people of Najd.

Asma bint Abi Bakr is called the one with two waistbands.
Imam al-Bukhari died in 256 AH.
hard.explain: Umar named six of the companions as a council. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Seventy prophets are named in the Qur'an.
Umar was stabbed while leading the prayer in the mosque.
The incident of the Ifk happened on the return from Banu al-Mustaliq.
hard.explain: Twenty-five prophets and messengers are named. The other two statements are correct.

hard.explain: He was of the Ash'ari tribe of Yemen. The other two statements are correct.

The Battle of Yamamah was fought against Musaylimah.
Ibn Taymiyyah was a student of Ibn Kathir.
hard.explain: Ibn Kathir (d. 774 AH) studied under Ibn Taymiyyah (d. 728 AH). The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Tirmidhi often graded hadith as hasan in his Jami'.
Ammar ibn Yasir was killed at Badr.
The prayers were first prescribed as fifty and reduced to five.
hard.explain: Ammar was killed at Siffin in 37 AH. The other two statements are correct.

Sawdah gave her day to Aishah.
hard.explain: Al-Ma'idah 89 names feeding ten needy people. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Isa spoke as a baby in the cradle.
Ka'b ibn Malik led the army to Tabuk.
Juwayriyah's people were freed after her marriage to the Prophet ﷺ.
hard.explain: Ka'b told the story of how he stayed behind and was forgiven. The other two statements are correct.

Al-Qaswa' was the mount of the Night Journey.
Dhul-Qarnayn travelled to where the sun sets and where it rises.
hard.explain: The Prophet ﷺ rode al-Buraq on the Isra. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Al-Khidr rebuilt a falling wall without asking for payment.
Abdullah ibn Ubayy led the archers at Uhud.
Umar turned back from al-Sham because of the plague.
hard.explain: He turned back with about a third of the army. The archers were led by Abdullah ibn Jubayr. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ahmad ibn Hanbal was persecuted in the Mihnah over the createdness of the Qur'an.
The Qur'an gives the husband four years in the case of ila'.
Umar set Dhat 'Irq as the miqat for Iraq.
hard.explain: Al-Baqarah 226: a wait of four months. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Ayat al-Kursi is the longest verse in the Qur'an.
Musa is the prophet named most often in the Qur'an.
The siege of Ta'if came after the Battle of Hunayn.
hard.explain: The verse of debt, Al-Baqarah 282, is the longest. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Seventy thousand angels enter al-Bayt al-Ma'mur every day.
The Prophet ﷺ made qunut against the killers of the reciters for a month.
Ibn Ishaq edited the Sirah of Ibn Hisham.
hard.explain: Ibn Ishaq wrote the earlier biography. Ibn Hisham edited it. The other two statements are correct.

statements: A mawquf report stops at a companion.
The six books of hadith include Sunan Ibn Majah.
The Qur'an calls Nuh "Khalil", the intimate friend of Allah.
hard.explain: Allah took Ibrahim as a close friend. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The People of the Ditch are mentioned in Surah Al-Buruj.
The Prophet ﷺ performed forty umrahs.
Talut tested his army by forbidding them to drink from a river.
hard.explain: Anas said four umrahs. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Umayyad capital was Damascus.
Abu Ayyub al-Ansari is buried in Yemen.
The People of the Sabbath were turned into apes.
hard.explain: He died on the expedition to Constantinople and was buried near its walls. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Abu Dharr's name was Abd al-Rahman ibn Sakhr.
The Prophet's she-camel al-Qaswa' knelt at Hudaybiyyah.
Salah al-Din retook Jerusalem after the Battle of Hattin.
hard.explain: Abu Dharr was Jundub ibn Junadah. Abd al-Rahman ibn Sakhr is a name given for Abu Hurayrah. The other two statements are correct.

statements: Abu Hanifah died in 250 AH.
The Dome of the Rock was built under Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan.
The expiation for zihar includes fasting two consecutive months.
hard.explain: Abu Hanifah died in 150 AH, the year al-Shafi'i was born. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The name Muhammad appears forty times in the Qur'an.
Hafsah was the daughter of Umar.
A bequest is limited to a third of the estate.
hard.explain: It appears in Ali 'Imran, Al-Ahzab, Muhammad and Al-Fath. The other two statements are correct.

statements: The Throne shook at the death of Sa'd ibn Mu'adh.
Surah An-Naml contains a basmalah in the middle of the surah.
The Prophet's ring was engraved with his date of birth.
hard.explain: He had a silver ring engraved Muhammad Rasul Allah. The other two statements are correct.
